records.observation_summary: The inspection found a missing complaint procedure and sterility failures released without a root cause.

observations.full_details: The firm had no written procedure describing how unresolved consumer complaints are escalated to quality.
Two sterility failures were closed without identifying a root cause or extending the investigation to distributed lots.

records.observation_summary: Batch records were incomplete for one compression lot.

observations.full_details: One batch production record was missing the second reviewer initials on the compression step.
